newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac Q1 shr $0.44 vs $0.40.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac Q1 shr $0.44 vs $0.40.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
Note: Analyst consensus for quarterly net share earnings was $0.44, according to First Call.
The company said its first quarter credit-related expenses totaled $144 million, a decrease of $3 million from fourth quarter 1996 and $12 million from first quarter of 1996.
The company said the decrease in credit-related expenses was due to a decline in REO operations expense.
The company said the February 1997 delinquency rate for single-family, at-risk mortgages was 0.60 percent, up 2 basis points from December 1996 and unchanged from March 1996.
The company said February 1997 delinquent multifamily balances were $142 million, down from $147 million at year end 1996 and $184 million at March 31, 1996.
